title: Delaware MathCounts
text:
The cutoff for nationals is usually below 30, but will fluctuate depending on the test difficulty.

These are the results from the 2025 Mathcounts state competition:

1st written: Edward Chen (H.B. Dupont Middle School) 2nd written: Joseph Zhang (The Independence School) 3rd written: Eric Chen (P.S. Middle School) 4th written: Alex Yao (Newark Charter)

Countdown (Unofficial) Winner: Alex Yao

These are the results from the 2024 Mathcounts state competition: 1st written: Edward Chen (H.B. Dupont Middle School) 2nd written: Satya Kokonda (Stanford Online High School) 3rd written: Jahl Miraji-Khot ( Alfred G Waters) 4th written: Eric Chen (P.S. Middle School)

Delaware placed 29th at the 2024 Mathcounts Nationals Competition. Delaware placed 34th at the 2025 Mathcounts Nationals Competition.

In the 2025 National competition, the Delaware participants placed 94th, 106th, 128th, and 144th.
